video_metadata.author: Government of India
video_metadata.description:
The BrahMos supersonic cruise missile with increased indigenous content and improved performance was successfully test fired today from Chandipur. 
Raksha Mantri Rajnathsingh congratulated the BrahMosMissile , DRDO teams and industry for the successful flight test
